C_COD_CREDITED_DEFECTS.rationale: The response identifies both credited robustness defects along with the inputs triggering them: an empty sequence/list passed to coupon_codes causing an IndexError, and any tier other than standard/premium causing a KeyError.

C_COD_FURTHER_PROBLEMS.rationale: The response identifies floating-point arithmetic for currency as a further defect and clearly explains why it matters: binary float division causes fractional-cent precision drift that desynchronizes finance totals and tax compliance rules.

C_COD_WHO_IS_AFFECTED.rationale: The response specifies who loses out (the merchant absorbs the full basket price and gives out a free order/unearned credit) and notes that while payment/ledger systems will throw errors and reject negative charges, zero amounts pass through as free orders.
